turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: No. Never. The blood stays on the blade, son.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Did you bring the boy for a charm, Priest?

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: No, Jack. For a baptism.

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: We'll send a few across the river today, Priest.

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote: What's the fight?

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote: Are you Native or Rabbit?

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote: Looks alright. I'll stand by you, then.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: I don't know you.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Derry?

turns.speaker: p5
turns.quote: Donnegal. Name's Monk Eastman.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: And you want to fight, Mr. Eastman?

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote: lf there's money in it.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Fight for the Natives. They have a proper war chest.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Let's see your skills, and we'll talk of payment later.

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote: Fine. But if you like what you see, pay me double.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Bill Poole! on whose challenge are we assembled?

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Bene.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: It wasn't God who touched your eye.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: I don't expect a death blow from your hand, Butcher. Let's have at it.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: There is another matter.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Say it out and quick, before spring gets here.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: So?

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Prepare to receive the Lord.

turns.speaker: p8
turns.quote: Yeah? Then you oughta be a red Indian.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: You need a weapon? Use a knife.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: It makes a deeper cut.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: Say a benediction, Priest.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: Ears and noses will be trophies of the day.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Can't..can't cross the river... with steel through my heart.

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote: That's yours, rightfully.

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote: And this is mine. Only what's owed. Use the rest for funeral.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: No!

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: It's fair.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Hon ...

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: No, Pa!

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: ... honor me... think of me ... don't never look away.

turns.speaker: p10
turns.quote: Take the body. Bring the boy.

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: Come an, lad. Therels nothing to be done now.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: Get away! Get away!

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Leave him be. He's his to mourn.

turns.speaker: p11
turns.quote: Where's your family, sonny?

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote: My mother's just there.

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote:
On the trip, her insides all broke up. She wasn't dead and there was three
others fighting for her bed.

turns.speaker: p11
turns.quote: And your father? Where's he, then?

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote: I never knew him.

turns.speaker: p11
turns.quote: We better see to you, then.

turns.speaker: p11
turns.quote:
Where all those streets come together right ahead is the true Five Points.
But most speak of the Five Points and mean anywhere between the Battery
and the Bowery.

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote: And those? What are those?

turns.speaker: p11
turns.quote: Well, those. Those are, as you might say, a sort of...

turns.speaker: p11
turns.quote: ... sort of whatnot.

turns.speaker: p13
turns.quote: Say, policeman. I'll buy your bonny friend.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: Easy, crusher. What's this all about?

turns.speaker: p14
turns.quote: Ask the boy.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: Make another Arrangement, looks like. For advertising.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: Better go along. I'll see to all this.

turns.speaker: p15
turns.quote: The boy...

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: Take the little malefactor.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: Give the boy what he paid for.

turns.speaker: p16
turns.quote: Ain't his first Tombs trip.

turns.speaker: p17
turns.quote: What do they call you?

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: Amsterdam.

turns.speaker: p17
turns.quote: Your full name.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: Vallon.

turns.speaker: p17
turns.quote: First name?

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: I told you.

turns.speaker: p17
turns.quote: Address?

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: Got none.

turns.speaker: p17
turns.quote: Well, where was they from when you had one?

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: City.

turns.speaker: p17
turns.quote: Disrobe.

turns.speaker: p17
turns.quote: What's the charge, Asbury?

turns.speaker: p15
turns.quote: Theft. Assault. Creating a ...

turns.speaker: p18
turns.quote: Ought to be served in a trough, properly. Will you try some?

turns.speaker: p19
turns.quote: Probably. What is it?

turns.speaker: p20
turns.quote: Your health.

turns.speaker: p21
turns.quote: Let me see! I don't believe it.

turns.speaker: p22
turns.quote: No! It's a danger.

turns.speaker: p21
turns.quote:
Oh come on! It's not.
(Friend shakes her head)
Then tell me where you got it.

turns.speaker: p22
turns.quote:
From some man. He took me in his carriage. He only wanted to do something
to me fast.

turns.speaker: p21
turns.quote: What?

turns.speaker: p22
turns.quote: I didn't understand.

turns.speaker: p21
turns.quote: Would he do the same with me?

turns.speaker: p22
turns.quote:
I won't tell you if he's around again.
(clutches penny tight)
He's my secret.

turns.speaker: p21
turns.quote: Better keep it more careful, then.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: You come into the Five Points and you stole from me.

turns.speaker: p23
turns.quote: I don't know...

turns.speaker: p23
turns.quote: You're a lunatic to come here like...

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote:
Thank you. Just listen good. The Native Americans holds the Five Points.
We have prevailed. What you do outside the Points is your deciding.
Outside is your city. Inside the Points is mine. Anyone who says
different, or does different, or thinks different...
(smiles)
... theylll draw my unwelcame attention. You understand?

turns.speaker: p24
turns.quote: I do understand, yes.

turns.speaker: p24
turns.quote: But you don't understand at all.

turns.speaker: p24
turns.quote: There's a whole city to share and all you see is your own narrow streets.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: You just stay out of my place.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: It's good work.

turns.speaker: p24
turns.quote: As far as it goes.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: You wouldn't be talking to me otherwise.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: We work for no one.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: Then get cops to do it.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: Appearance means nothing.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: If you can talk plain, maybe we can do business.

turns.speaker: p23
turns.quote: Anyone inside?

turns.speaker: p25
turns.quote: No, praise God, but all we own...

turns.speaker: p23
turns.quote: Waiting on reinforcements.

turns.speaker: p26
turns.quote: May I point out that the building is burning to ashes?

turns.speaker: p27
turns.quote: Another proud night for Tammany, Bill.

turns.speaker: p23
turns.quote:
Just tell them...
(lowers his voice)
... to take enough to share. And not to steal so in the open.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: Satisfied?

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote: Satisfied? It wasn't me that's been dancing and shagging all night.

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote: The hell.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: Goddamn it.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: Goddamn you anyway.

turns.speaker: p28
turns.quote: What's the trouble, Don?

turns.speaker: p29
turns.quote: There's someone here.

turns.speaker: p28
turns.quote: It's just a man of commerce.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: You're right enough this time, Monk.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: Go ahead.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: Go on with your work. I'll finish my business.

turns.speaker: p28
turns.quote: Come out with it then.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: You damn craven, do it!

turns.speaker: p28
turns.quote: What the hell...

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: Your eyes was open for that alright. And you still got one to see this.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: If I was you I'd use that to open in a new location. Consider St. Louis.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: The war club.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: I promise you, Amsterdam. I promise you.

turns.speaker: p30
turns.quote:
I may enjoy the bounty of your table and the pleasures of your company,
Mr. Tweed ...

turns.speaker: p24
turns.quote: And the pleasures of the company provided you, Mr. Greeley.

turns.speaker: p30
turns.quote: ...without the Tribune endorsing your politics.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: I'm not good enough for your table, so I eat where I can. (takes a big

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: bite)

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: It's good, what is it?

turns.speaker: p24
turns.quote: Pheasant.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: He never had his own cross. Thanks.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote:
Your touch is light, but as a tracker you work awful heavy. Come ahead.
Now that I met your mother, you should come and meet my father.

turns.speaker: p21
turns.quote: You should finish the stone.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote:
It'll be finished when everything's finished. That's when helll rest. The
hand that killed him is the hand that will bury him in peace.

turns.speaker: p21
turns.quote: It was Bill killed him, not you.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: With my hand on the knife.

turns.speaker: p21
turns.quote: And his hand on yours!

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote:
And me feeling the life go out of my father! He looked at me ... he looked
at me and he swore me with his eyes. I could feel his spirit... I say I
could feel it rising... flowing through the knife like blood into my own
heart.

turns.speaker: p21
turns.quote: You talk like he lives in you.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote:
I don't want him to live, I want him dead! I kill Bill and I'm free of
them both!

turns.speaker: p21
turns.quote:
You think you can be free that easy? You need your way so clear, and
you''' use anything to clear it. Anyone, too. Me, everybody, we're all
just a way for you to settle your damned ghosts.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote:
You're part of me now, like the gang is part of me and my father both. If
I can bring us to glory, then my father... like The Book says...my father
can enter his house justified.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote:
All of us is set on the same road together. The gang can have everything
they ever wanted and get me what I want while they're doing it. We're not
interfering with each other, we're helping each other. It's all the same,
we're all one together.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote:
We'll all have a share of the profit like we'll all have a portion of the
fame. If we come to be notorious, that only means we're strong, and if
we're strong that means we're ready.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote:
And I'll know that time, know it right off when it comes. Just like I knew
you.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: Now! Finish him now!

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote: Our man will take him in another five. What puts you in such a hurry?

turns.speaker: p31
turns.quote:
I want to extend thanks and admiration not only to our two combatants
today, but to their sponsors, the Dead Rabbits ...
(indicates one side of the ring)
... and the Native Americans.

turns.speaker: p31
turns.quote:
Their generous support allows me to bring you this splendid exhibition.
With their indulgence I'd like to remind you also of the further wonders
that await you at my new Museum, located on Broadway...

turns.speaker: p31
turns.quote: ... fists up!

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote:
Dobbs will take him this round. That'll be something. The Natives has
never lost before.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: Because there's never been a Dead Rabbit fighting before.

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote: That'll shame them thorough.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote:
There'll be worse than shaming. We only got the Natives in range.

It's time to squeeze the trigger, John.

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote:
Don't push the Natives too far, Amsterdam. Otherwise it'll be Tammany
pushing back.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: That don't matter any more.

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote:
It does matter, and it's going to matter even more. Tammany's the heart
and future of this city. If the Rabbits is going to keep growing, we're
going to have to throw in with Tammany some way.

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote:
They got that Conscription Act from Washington keeping them busy, but they
won't leave us alone forever. And the Natives is strong as they ever been!

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote:
(indicates Fighter 1)
You call that strong, John?

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote:
(to Johnny)
This is our time now!

turns.speaker: p32
turns.quote: We're with you, don't harm us!

turns.speaker: p33
turns.quote: Show us your spirit and come out with us then!

turns.speaker: p21
turns.quote: What is it?

turns.speaker: p34
turns.quote: Cops has everything closed to the north, and the militia's coming.

turns.speaker: p35
turns.quote: My Daddy don't have to die for you! Why should he fight and die for you?

turns.speaker: p21
turns.quote: I'd kill you for this.

turns.speaker: p36
turns.quote: How's that?

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: Are you with us, then?

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: Good. We're going for the Armory at Canal Street.

turns.speaker: p36
turns.quote: The Armory! We'll have to beat the militia to get there.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: There's a way through the lines. Jen, did you see the cops and militia?

turns.speaker: p36
turns.quote: Why, we going to take a sail to Europe?

turns.speaker: p21
turns.quote: Seems we are.

turns.speaker: p30
turns.quote: They attacked me! I had every sympathy for them at first...

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: Where's the Native Americans?

turns.speaker: p37
turns.quote: Ain't seen them. Ain't here.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: And the militia?

turns.speaker: p37
turns.quote: The Devil himself couldn't take that place.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: That's why he sent us.

turns.speaker: p21
turns.quote:
(crying)
Help me. Oh please help me. He's shot, we need a doctor, please help.

turns.speaker: p38
turns.quote:
Miss, we ain't a medical outfit. The main unit's ten minutes behind us,
they'll have...

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: Help us, we got wounded!

turns.speaker: p39
turns.quote: We can't leave the post.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: Open the damn doors then! We're bad hurt!

turns.speaker: p39
turns.quote: Where's the others?

turns.speaker: p39
turns.quote: God, it's good to see you!

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: Likewise.

turns.speaker: p27
turns.quote: It's from the Armory Guards. That's the last before the wire went dead.

turns.speaker: p27
turns.quote: They got to be near.

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote:
So long as they're near, it's alright. The Rabbits can take the Armory,
but they can't hold it. If Bill can get into position, he can make sure
they don't get out.

turns.speaker: p24
turns.quote:
Alright then, John, you pray to any God you choose that's the fact of it.
If Bill thinks he can best the Natives, that is your opportunity. That is
your moment.
(Johnny hesitates)
Are you a Bible man? The Book says in Revelations, "I saw a new heaven and
a new earth." If the hand of God's not on you to fulfill that prophecy,
then the hand of Tweed will be. Go on and God bless.

turns.speaker: p40
turns.quote: I don't believe he can do it, Tweed.

turns.speaker: p24
turns.quote:
Oh, I think he can. Whether it's one man against another or a mob against
the city, the mathematics remain the same. You never enjoyed the
enlightenment of poverty, did you, Governor? If you had, you'd know you
can always hire half the poor to kill the other half.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: We move now and we can drive them out! We press them and they'll break!

turns.speaker: p41
turns.quote: I can't spare the men or stand the risk! We stay fast and smoke lem out!

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote:
Tweed put me in charge of this! I say we move, and by the crucified Christ
we will move!
(turns to his men)
Native Americans, come with me! Any militia that wants to live upright
instead of die hunkered down, come with us!

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: We'll show you gladiators' greatness! Come on!

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: Was it Tweed or your friend put you to this?

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote: Tweed.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: You'd lie to save your friend.

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote: No. There's no friends for me.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: Me the same. Pity us both.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: Hold your fire!

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: In there! Hey in there! I want to talk to Amsterdam!

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: Go on, then, talk.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: You and me.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: Come ahead then. And bring my friend's body.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: Your friend made different friends lately.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: Tammany's put us all in the same place. You want to get out alive?

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: You'd lay aside what's between us?

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: I'm not forgetting where I put it.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: If you do, I'll remind you.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: What's your call, Bill?

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: I'm considering where's my better chance.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: Go ahead them, give them cover! Give them some damn cover!

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: Well, it seems like between us we got two mobs that might make a gang.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: Whose gang might it be?

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: Not William Tweed's.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: Which way you pointing that?

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: They got to come in if we're going to fight them.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: Who do you want to fight, Bill?

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: See you in the street.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: You'll have a warrior's funeral anyway, John.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: We're finished, all of us.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: But you and me ain't settled.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote:
We got the same now, a full share of nothing. There's nothing to settle.
There's nothing left.

turns.speaker: p9
turns.quote: Then let's start over.
